meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-08-26 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.badge: Least deep sleep of the seven
en.rec: This was the recovery night after yesterday's deadlift session, and it did most of its job — just not the part you want most. The score is 78 on 6h 52m, lights out at 23:08 and awake at 06:12. Two things moved at once. Bedtime slipped 48 minutes from Monday's 22:20, and the wake at 06:12 was the earliest of the seven nights, so the window itself was 1h 08m shorter than the night before and 5 minutes under the 6h 57m seven-night average. That is not a bad night; it is a compressed one, and both ends contributed. Quality inside the window was actually strong. Only 12 minutes awake across the whole night — the least of any night here — for 97% efficiency, second only to Friday 21's 99%. The problem is depth. Deep sleep came in at 33 minutes, 8% of the night, and that is the lowest reading of the seven: down from 50 on Monday and 86 minutes under Friday 21's 119. Two nights in a row now with deep in the low band. REM held up at 96 minutes, 23% of the night, and light took the rest at 283. So the night was efficient and well-structured, just short and shallow at the bottom. The autonomic side is steady, slightly soft. HRV read 38, three below the 41 seven-night average and the lowest since Wednesday 19's 34 — this is the first HRV dip that lines up with a hard session the day before, which is exactly what you would expect after three sets of 120 kg at RPE 8.5. RHR held flat at 54, one above the 53 average and unchanged from Monday, so there is no sign of accumulated strain. Overnight stress read 17, the lowest of the window. Body Battery charged 51. Readiness lands at 74, good — a notch below Monday's 76, driven by the shorter night and the softer HRV rather than by anything alarming. The lever here is bedtime, and only bedtime. Your wake time has been pinned near 06:15 for a week; you cannot buy sleep at that end. 22:20 produced 8h 00m. 23:08 produced 6h 52m. That is the whole equation. Get lights out by 22:40 tonight, and hold it for three or four nights in a row — deep sleep responds to consistency far more than to any single early night, and 33 minutes is the one number on this board worth chasing.

hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.badge: Najmanje dubokog sna od sedam noći
hr.rec: Ovo je bila noć oporavka nakon jučerašnjeg mrtvog dizanja i odradila je najveći dio posla — samo ne onaj dio koji ti najviše treba. Ocjena je 78 uz 6h 52m, svjetlo se ugasilo u 23:08, a buđenje je bilo u 06:12. Dvije stvari pomaknule su se istodobno. Lijeganje je kasnilo 48 minuta u odnosu na ponedjeljkovih 22:20, a buđenje u 06:12 bilo je najranije od sedam noći, pa je sam prozor bio 1h 08m kraći nego prethodne noći i 5 minuta ispod sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 6h 57m. To nije loša noć; to je stisnuta noć, a obje strane su tome pridonijele. Kvaliteta unutar prozora zapravo je bila dobra. Svega 12 minuta budnosti kroz cijelu noć — najmanje od svih noći ovdje — uz 97% učinkovitosti, odmah iza petkovih 99%. Problem je dubina. Duboki san iznosio je 33 minute, 8% noći, i to je najniža vrijednost od sedam: manje od ponedjeljkovih 50 i 86 minuta ispod petkovih 119. Već druga noć zaredom s dubokim snom u niskom razredu. REM se održao na 96 minuta, 23% noći, a laki san uzeo je ostatak sa 283. Dakle, noć je bila učinkovita i dobro strukturirana, samo kratka i plitka pri dnu. Autonomna strana je stabilna, malo mekša. HRV je iznosio 38, tri ispod sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 41 i najniže od srijede 19. i njezinih 34 — ovo je prvi pad HRV-a koji se poklapa s teškim treningom dan ranije, što je točno ono što se očekuje nakon tri serije od 120 kg uz RPE 8,5. RHR je ostao na 54, jedan iznad prosjeka od 53 i nepromijenjen od ponedjeljka, pa nema znaka nakupljenog opterećenja. Noćni stres iznosio je 17, najniže u prozoru. Body Battery napunio se 51 bod. Spremnost je 74, dobra — stepenicu ispod ponedjeljkovih 76, zbog kraće noći i mekšeg HRV-a, a ne zbog ičega zabrinjavajućeg. Poluga je ovdje vrijeme lijeganja, i samo ono. Buđenje ti je već tjedan dana prikovano oko 06:15; s te strane ne možeš kupiti san. 22:20 je donijelo 8h 00m. 23:08 je donijelo 6h 52m. To je cijela jednadžba. Ugasi svjetlo do 22:40 večeras i zadrži to tri-četiri noći zaredom — duboki san reagira na dosljednost daleko više nego na jednu ranu noć, a 33 minute jedini je broj na ovoj ploči vrijedan lova.
